items.text: 3/4 The Human Rights Campaign (HRC) released its online harassment report that showed 24 different hospitals and medical providers, spanning across 21 states, have recently been subjected to direct online attacks following misleading and harassing posts by anti-LGBTQ+ accounts.

4/4 I spoke with HRC President Kelley Robinson about how these coordinated hate campaigns against hospitals and other medical providers have resulted in the harassment, physical violence, and even death of people in the LGBTQ+ community. https://t.co/wgrE4fb9a9

1/3 Today the Oversight Committee adopted my amendment to the DRUG Act that would protect 8 M federal employees, retirees & their families from being overcharged for prescription drugs by Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBM) under the Federal Employee Health Benefits Program (FEHBP).

2/3 The FEHBP is widely considered the gold standard when it comes to affordable healthcare, yet we found that federal workers were being overcharged for drugs so PBMs could pocket the difference in price.

I’m proud to join my friend and colleague @RepMarkGreen to cosponsor this legislation to provide additional healthcare and benefits to K2 veterans. 

As evidenced by our two year investigation, thousands of service members that were deployed to Karshi-Khanabad Air Base in Uzbekistan after September 11th were exposed to multiple toxic hazards and chemicals, including dangerous petrochemicals and burn pits. 

These veterans continue to battle debilitating health conditions, including unusual advanced-stage cancers, and yet the VA refuses to fully acknowledge the link between their service at K2 and their illness. 

We must make every effort to ensure that K2 Veterans and their families receive full healthcare and disability benefits that are reflective of their service and sacrifice to our nation.
